author: Your loving cousin, Tervyn
pages:
Dear cousin,

The Duke has been very kind. I have a house in Bliss with a garden that sings, mostly in the mornings. The cheese here is extraordinary. The neighbours are mostly fine.

I am told the other half of the city is called Crucible and that I must never go there after dark. Or before dark. I am told many things.

The weather changes when He is in a mood. Last week it rained fish, which the cooks were pleased about, and then it rained forks, which the cooks were less pleased about.

Please do not come to visit. Not because I don't miss you, but because the door only opens one way for some people, and I have not yet worked out which way it opens for me.

P.S. Bring cheese.
